names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 17 aprilie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Simeon, Episcopul Persiei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Συμεών επίσκοπος Περσίας…», with the rank word and the see left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 17 April, „Свешт. муч. Симеон епископ Персијски.“, with Св. left off — it is not a rank — with Свешт. муч. left off, which is the `hieromartyr` this folder already carries in `types`, and with епископ Персијски left off, a rank and a see this corpus keeps in `types` and in the display name. The heading gives no epithet beyond the see, so the bare forename is what the source leaves.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 17 апреля ст. ст., name page 2001, «Святитель Симеон Ктезифонтский, Селевкийский (Персидский), епископ, сщмч.», with the rank word and the office left off; the day's own line gives the name in the genitive, «Симеона». No folder in this corpus holds this form, and the gate's key for it has no other holder, measured. All three epithets are the calendar's own nominative and are kept, brackets and all, since the gate's key drops brackets anyway; the corpus keeps more than forty folders on this forename, so the key was measured rather than guessed.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Симеона , еп. Персидского, и с ним мчч. @6[Авделая] и Анании пресвитеров, Хусдазата евнуха, Фусика , Азата , мч. Аскитреи и иных многих (344).»
source.note: The day's first entry, and the first of the three to carry a typikon icon, whose alt reads «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. Its year, 344, is the second of the two this folder already holds, and **its life gives the day of his death, «13 апреля 344», which no source read for this folder had stated** — four days before the day that keeps him, which is neither the day page's number nor a difference of thirteen, so BRIEF.md §8 leaves the day page standing and the difference is recorded here. The line enumerates six of the company and closes «и иных многих», and many others, who are not named; the life counts a thousand martyrs, then another hundred and another hundred and fifty. **The day page's markup for the first presbyter is broken — it prints «@6[Авделая]», an unexpanded template, and he alone of the six has no `name:` link behind him.** The name page for the entry (2001) gives «День памяти: 17 апреля» and no other day, and its «Служба» line names the three the day's service is for: the bishop, Acacius of Melitene and Zosimas of Solovki. None of the day's four hymns is this company's. Two of the company had no folder here before this batch and now have one.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 17 aprilie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Simeon, Episcopul Persiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Συμεών επίσκοπος Περσίας και οι μαρτυρήσαντες μαζί μ' αυτόν Αύδελας ο πρεσβύτερος, Γοθαζάτ, Φουσίκ και άλλοι 1150»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him on. The page gives him no year: it sets him only «κατά τους χρόνους του βασιλέως των Περσών Σαβωρίου», whom it names again as Σαπώρ ο Β’, so no `dates` were taken. It names three of his companions — the presbyter Audelas, Gothazat and Phousik — and gives each a couplet of his own, so each has a folder; the other 1150 are named nowhere. Its verse numbers them in two lots, «Eις τους εκατόν πεντήκοντα» and «Eις τους χιλίους», and its third line names the day, «Ἑβδομάτῃ Συμεὼν δεκάτῃ ἀπὸ αὐχένα τμήθη».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 30.04.2026 (17. април ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Симеон епископ Персијски.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek both keep him on. **The heading names him and nobody else**, so this entry is one row and not a company's worth, on the ruling made for `asyncritus-the-apostle` on the Julian 8 April: the row rests on the heading. The body does name six others who died in the same persecution — the presbyters Авделај and Ананија, the king's eunuch Устазан, the officer Фусик, his daughter the virgin Аскитреја, and the eunuch Азат a year later on Great Friday — and the corpus keeps folders for four of them, but not one of those names is in the heading, so **no row and no name form was written for any of them** and the entry's account of them stands in this folder's life, where the Romanian life already told it. **The year is new to this folder**: „Сви чесно пострадаше за Христа Цара и Господа 341. или 344. год.“ — 341 or 344, the page disagreeing with itself, recorded as the interval it is. The Romanian life this folder was written from says in so many words that no year is given anywhere on its page, and saint.gr gives none either, so nothing was displaced. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge, Sfinţite Mucenice Simeon, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Simeon, Episcopul Persiei», Glasul 4

english.text: Sharer in the apostles' way and successor to their thrones, you found in action, O inspired of God, an ascent to contemplation. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth, you kept the faith and endured unto blood, O hieromartyr Simeon: entreat Christ our God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Ὡς ὑποφήτης τῶν ἐνθέων δογμάτων, Μαρτυρικὸν συνασπισμὸν ἐπαλείφεις, λόγοις ὁμοὺ καὶ πράξεσι πρὸς ἄθλους ἱερούς, μεθ' ὧν καὶ συνήθλησας, Συμεὼν Ἱεράρχα, καὶ Χριστῷ ἀνέδραμες, σὺν αὐτοὶς ἀνακράζων. Ἰδοὺ ἠμεῖς ὡς πρόβατα σφαγῆς, τὴ σῆ ἀγάπη, Σωτὴρ ἐλογίσθημεν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὃ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of Άγιος Συμεών επίσκοπος Περσίας. It is his own, names him, and has the company contending beside him.

english.text: As an interpreter of the divine doctrines thou didst anoint a band of martyrs, by words and by deeds together, for the holy contests; and having contended along with them, Simeon the hierarch, thou didst run up to Christ, crying out with them: behold, for thy love, O Saviour, we were counted as sheep for the slaughter.

hymns.text: Τῶν ἁγίων Μαρτύρων τά κατορθώματα, οὐρανῶν αἱ δυνάμεις ὑπερεθαύμασαν, ὅτι ἐν σώματι θνητῷ τόν ἀσώματον ἐχθρόν, τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Σταυροῦ ἀγωνισάμενοι καλῶς, ἐνίκησαν ἀοράτως, καὶ νῦν πρεσβεύουσι τῷ Κυρίῳ, ἐλεηθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, on the page of Άγιος Συμεών επίσκοπος Περσίας. This is the common apolytikion of martyrs and names nobody; the page prints it under his name, so it is copied whole as the page has it.

english.text: The powers of the heavens marvelled greatly at the achievements of the holy martyrs: that in a mortal body, having contended well by the power of the Cross, they overcame the bodiless enemy invisibly; and now they intercede with the Lord that our souls may find mercy.

hymns.text: Ἐκ Περσίδος ἔλαμψας ὡς ἑωσφόρος, Συμεών μακάριε, δῆμον Ἁγίων Ἀθλητῶν, ἔχων ἡμῖν συνανίσχοντας, ὥσπερ ἀστέρας· μεθ᾽ὧν εὐφημοῦμέν σε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of Άγιος Συμεών επίσκοπος Περσίας. It is his own, names him and names Persia.

english.text: Out of Persia thou didst shine like the morning star, blessed Simeon, having a whole people of holy contenders rising with thee for us like stars; and with them we praise thee.

death.note: One page disagreeing with itself, recorded as an interval with nothing chosen, on docs/CORPUS.md §3's rule. The Ohrid Prologue for 17. април ст. ст. closes the entry „Сви чесно пострадаше за Христа Цара и Господа 341. или 344. год.“ — all suffered honourably for Christ the King and Lord in 341 or 344. The folder held no `dates` before: doxologia's long life, which this folder was written from, says in so many words that no year is given anywhere on its page, and saint.gr prints none. The entry puts the eunuch Азат's death a year after Simeon's, on Great Friday, so the interval is the bishop's own year as the page gives it and not the company's span. No year of birth is recorded anywhere read.
